OUR CAPABILITIES

01

Pumps & pumping systems

Slurry, water, borehole, peristaltic and dewatering pumps. Equipment selection and supply for the application at hand.

  • Slurry pumps and spares
  • Water and borehole pumps
  • Peristaltic and dewatering pumps
  • Pump assembly and equipment supply
02

Spares & accessories

Components to support your pumping systems, from wear parts and liners to piping and drive components.

  • Rubber and metal wear parts
  • Impellers, liners and throat bushes
  • Piping, fittings, valves and couplings
  • Single- and double-acting air torque actuators
03

Installation & maintenance

Technical services that support equipment throughout its working life.

  • Equipment installation
  • Slurry pump repair and maintenance
  • Fault finding and reporting
  • Piping and fittings fabrication
04

Underground vehicle support

Supply and maintenance services for underground light and heavy vehicles.

  • Vehicle spare parts
  • Repair and maintenance
  • Diagnostics and programming
